question: What rare matter, difficult for the gods to obtain, has been asked of Bhairava?
premises: The speaker states he has been asked.
The matter asked about is hard for the gods to obtain.
inference: Bhairava acknowledges being asked about a matter difficult even for the gods to obtain.
plain_english: Well said, well said, O great goddess; I have been asked about what is hard for even the gods to obtain.
